title: Block Tales Swords
description: Block Tales' SFOTH swords but in Minecraft
body:
This datapack adds the SFOTH swords and gives them their abilities from the Roblox game Block Tales. There are currently 4 swords available in this pack.

![all 4 swords](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fa6f3a82a78267925395d832ce6b7c0b439b4d3a.png)
- Ice Dagger
- Venomshank
- Ghostwalker
- Firebrand

Type **/trigger BlockTalesSwords** in game to get more help.

**NOTE: The zip file is both a datapack AND a resource pack, so if you want the custom textures, make sure to put in your worlds datapack folder AND your resource pack folder!**

Credit to Spaceman Moonbase for the Block Tales game, the Medjed sprite, and the Card sprites.
You can play Block Tales [here.](https://www.roblox.com/games/16483433878/Block-Tales-DEMO-4)
